topics.title: Commute Routine
topics.summary: A confirmed Monday/Wednesday school routine with different focus for each commute, plus a one-week trial before evaluating it.

nodes.title: Weekly schedule
nodes.content: The confirmed routine is to go to school Monday and Wednesday, waking at 7:00 and leaving at 7:45. Try it for one week before judging whether it works.

evidence.quote: 周一和周三去学校，七点起床，七点四十五出门
先试一周再判断是否合理

nodes.title: Earlier timing
nodes.content: The earlier 6:30 wake-up and 7:00 departure plan was superseded.

evidence.quote: 每天六点半起床，七点出门
六点半太早

nodes.title: Commute focus
nodes.content: Use Monday morning to think about experiments and Wednesday travel to study papers; focus on one main question during the commute.

evidence.quote: 周一早上讨论实验，周三路上学习论文
路上只聊一个主要问题

nodes.title: Pacing and review
nodes.content: Travel planning should allow brief reflection without staring at a screen, leave unscheduled time, and reserve detailed review for arrival or evening.

evidence.quote: 不能一直盯屏幕
不要把所有空余时间都塞满
到了之后再看详细记录
不要把旧的六点半当作最终决定

topics.title: Voice Knowledge Product
topics.summary: A personal-first voice tool for continuing thought across topics, with a knowledge-map interface, source-preserving summaries, and interruption recovery.

nodes.title: Conversation model
nodes.content: The proposed tool supports long-running thought through Talk and Workspace. Users speak directly without creating a session; topic association can be handled later.

evidence.quote: 入口只有 Talk 和 Workspace
用户直接说话，不用先新建 session
后台以后再判断应该关联哪些主题

nodes.title: Knowledge map interface
nodes.content: Workspace should present a large connected knowledge map with editable ideas and questions, rather than many cards. The interface should be in English, avoid green, and use a dark primary button.

evidence.quote: 一张大的知识地图
不要做成大量卡片列表
界面用英文，主按钮深色

nodes.title: Source and revision history
nodes.content: Keep original utterances, show sources for AI summaries, and mark superseded decisions rather than silently replacing them. AI suggestions must not be recorded as user-confirmed decisions.

evidence.quote: 原始发言永远保留
AI 总结要能指出来源
旧决定应该标为被修订，不能默默覆盖
不能把 AI 提议记成我确认的决定

nodes.title: First-version scope
nodes.content: The first version is for personal commute use, not Slack integration or team permissions. Prioritize interruption, context recovery, and organizing outcomes afterward; team service is only a possible future direction.

evidence.quote: 第一版先做我自己的通勤体验
不做 Slack 集成，不做团队权限
优先解决打断、恢复上下文和结束后的成果整理

nodes.title: Topic boundary rules
nodes.content: Whether users confirm topic boundaries and whether consecutive topics are split into separate records remain unresolved. The tentative preference is AI suggestion followed by user confirmation.

evidence.quote: 主题边界是否由用户确认
连续多个话题要不要拆分成不同记录
我的倾向是 AI 建议、用户确认

nodes.title: Test and success criteria
nodes.content: Next, prepare a test checklist and record a conversation with topic changes and revisions. Success means restoring the right topic, retaining original sources, and not turning guesses into decisions.

evidence.quote: 整理一个测试清单
录一段包含话题切换和修改意见的对话
总结中不把猜想写成决定

topics.title: GPU Inference Benchmark
topics.summary: A separate legal-document summarization project focused on measured inference scheduling comparisons, quality checks, and hardware-aware profiling.

nodes.title: Project scope
nodes.content: This project concerns inference optimization, not model training, using public legal documents and the same model to compare batching strategies for throughput and latency.

evidence.quote: 先做推理优化，不是训练模型
数据是公开法律文档
比较相同模型下不同批处理策略的吞吐和延迟

nodes.title: Batching comparisons
nodes.content: Use arrival-order batching as the baseline and compare length bucketing for documents from 1,000 to 24,000 tokens. Keep same-batch-size results separate from token-budget batching results, and report same-memory-budget results separately.

evidence.quote: 基线先用原来的按到达顺序 batching
文档长度从一千到两万四千 token
应该作为另一项实验单独比较
两者不能混在一起

nodes.title: Measurement controls
nodes.content: Fix output length and batch size when attributing gains to scheduling. Check the school server's GPU model, available memory, and CUDA environment; do not assume an A100 or report unmeasured gains or local simulations as GPU measurements.

evidence.quote: 要固定输出长度和 batch size
不能假定有 A100
没有测过的百分之二十五提升不能写进结果
不要把本地模拟时间当作 GPU 实测

nodes.title: Summary quality checks
nodes.content: Check key facts, dates, amounts, and holdings. Start with a 20-document smoke test, then expand toward 400 documents; 400 is a target, not a completed run.

evidence.quote: 检查关键事实、日期、金额和裁判结论
先选二十篇做 smoke test
四百篇只是目标，现在不代表已经跑完

nodes.title: Prefill and decode costs
nodes.content: Measure whether long legal documents make prefill the dominant cost, or whether decode matters more when output is long.

evidence.quote: 长法律文档是否让 prefill 成为主要成本
这个应该用测量回答

nodes.title: Next steps and profiling
nodes.content: Confirm access to the school machine and run the arrival-order baseline. Treat writing a CUDA kernel as later exploration; profile first rather than presuming attention is the best target.

evidence.quote: 确认学校机器登录，再跑按到达顺序的基线
先看 profiler 确认瓶颈
不能直接认定 attention kernel 最值得优化

topics.title: Inference Paper Learning
topics.summary: A learning record, distinct from the GPU experiment, for understanding KV cache, prefill/decode, and inference scheduling through source materials.

nodes.title: KV cache
nodes.content: The initial understanding is that KV cache avoids recomputing prior tokens' keys and values during autoregressive generation. Its relation to length bucketing is still a question; the current distinction is tentative and should be checked against original papers.

evidence.quote: 避免自回归生成时反复计算之前 token 的 key 和 value
不太清楚它和文档长度分桶有什么关系
请先作为待验证笔记
不要作为实验结论

nodes.title: Prefill and decode
nodes.content: Understand the difference between prefill and decode and confirm which stages KV cache applies to.

evidence.quote: 还需要理解 prefill 和 decode 的差别
确认 KV cache 的适用阶段

nodes.title: Reading plan
nodes.content: The planned reading order is original papers on KV cache and inference scheduling, followed by a systems implementation. Whether to do quantization remains undecided.

evidence.quote: 先找 KV cache 和推理调度的原始论文
再读一个系统实现
暂时不确定要不要做量化

nodes.title: Learning notes
nodes.content: Keep terminology explanations and open questions in the learning record, with explanations traceable to materials and original utterances.

evidence.quote: 学习记录保留术语解释和开放问题
所有解释都要能回到材料和原始发言
确认 KV cache 的适用阶段，理解 prefill 和 decode
我自己上下学就是语音产品的第一批真实测试
这个日程属于个人规划，不应该被混进产品需求文档
论文学习和 GPU 项目有关，但不是同一个东西
它们之间可以建立连接
